name.en: Resistance at Beiping–Tianjin and the Battle of Shanghai

description.zh: 示意初稿，待史料校订：第 29 军守卢沟桥、平津，随后战事扩大至上海。
description.en: Illustrative draft pending historical review: the 29th Army defended the Marco Polo Bridge and Beiping–Tianjin before fighting spread to Shanghai.

description.zh: 示意初稿，待史料校订：淞沪会战后中国军队西撤，国民政府机关逐步迁往重庆。
description.en: Illustrative draft pending historical review: after Shanghai, Chinese forces withdrew west and government organs gradually relocated to Chongqing.

description.zh: 示意初稿，待史料校订：1945 年夏中国军队在广西发起局部反攻，先后收复桂柳、南宁。
description.en: Illustrative draft pending historical review: in summer 1945 Chinese forces counterattacked in Guangxi and recovered Guilin, Liuzhou, and Nanning.
